title: Ledgerloop: the ledger that pays itself
audience: series B pitch to fintech-focused institutional investors
core_points: Thesis: merchants are leaving 4-6% on the table because settlement + reconciliation live in separate systems
Ledgerloop unifies real-time settlement with on-chain receipts in a single write
Live metrics: $2.8B settled month-to-date, 99.994% uptime, 11bps average cost
Customer wins: Rocket Retail cut reconciliation team from 9 to 2 FTE in one quarter
Moat: proprietary multi-rail router beats naive ACH+card by 38bps on average transaction
Business model: 8bps of settled volume + $0.02 per reconciliation event, 71% gross margin
Growth: 11% compounding MoM volume over trailing 9 months
Competitive lane: Stripe Treasury does money movement, we're the reconciliation layer that sits above
Roadmap: FedNow + RTP integration Q2, embedded lending Q4
Capital ask: $48M Series B to hit $100B ARR volume by Q4 2027
